effect_description_eng:
[Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.
[On Play] Trash 3 digivolution cards from the bottom of 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Until the end of your opponent's next turn, 1 of your opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards can't attack or block.
